before: async function* defines an async generator. Calling asyncLabels(labels, events) returns an async iterator; its body advances when requested. Its Symbol.asyncIterator method returns that iterator, and next() returns a Promise for a value/done record. for await...of awaits each record rather than treating a Promise as the item.

yield await Promise.resolve(label) yields one resolved label. The surrounding finally appends closed when the generator exits. Returning from inside for await...of asks the iterator to close, including awaiting its return() cleanup when that method exists. This is cooperative protocol cleanup, not an automatic cancellation rule for arbitrary background operations.
after:
An async generator supplies values that may need waiting for. Write it with `async function*`.

Its `next()` method returns a Promise for the next value-and-done record. `for await...of` waits for each record before using it.

`yield await Promise.resolve(label)` waits for a label, then yields it.

Our generator has a `finally` block that records `closed` when it exits. Returning early from `for await...of` asks this generator to close and waits for its cleanup.
